goal: Remove workstation-specific temporary-directory assumptions discovered by PR CI without changing runtime behavior.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The three new test suites resolve the platform temporary root instead of requiring the local agent directory.
Focused tests and full local repository gate pass after the test-only repair.

outcome.summary: Test setup now uses the real platform temporary directory. Seventy-one focused tests and the full local gate pass; remote CI is checked before merge.

what_worked: CI exposed a portability failure absent on the development machine.
Canonical temporary-root resolution follows existing gateway test conventions.
what_failed: New tests assumed a workstation-specific directory existed on GitHub runners.

evidence.summary: Three repaired suites pass 71 tests; full local gate passes 1357 tests with seven integration skips, types, build, capsules and deterministic gates.
Initial PR CI failed because the local-agent temporary directory was absent; no paid calls or runtime changes were involved.

notes: The user requested commit, push, PR and merge; the next remote CI run remains the merge gate.
